questions.question: This repo has an in-progress uroboros run for the order lifecycle feature (buyers cancel orders, sellers fulfill them, parties view order detail). It is still registered to an earlier Claude session. Its design phases are done (specify through analyze all passed review) and implementation hasn't started. If this session takes it over, the earlier session will no longer keep it alive or resume it. What should happen?

options.label: Take it over
options.description: This session resumes the run at implementation; the earlier session's claim on it ends.

options.label: Stop this run
options.description: Leave the run with the earlier session and do nothing here.

questions.question: The order lifecycle feature is built and verified. Three of the decisions you made during it could also bind future features in this project. If saved as standing decisions, later runs won't ask them again. (1) Cancelling an order never takes back the ranking score the order gave its listing. (2) A cancelled or fulfilled order is final: no action changes it again. (3) Admins can see every order but never cancel or fulfill one on a buyer's or seller's behalf. Which should be saved?

options.label: Add none
options.description: Nothing is saved; future runs may ask these again.

options.label: Add all listed
options.description: Save all three as project-wide standing decisions.

questions.question: This run made three product decisions that could apply to the whole project, not just this feature. If saved, future runs treat them as settled and never ask them again. (1) Only an open order can be cancelled or fulfilled; any other order is refused, including a second cancel or fulfill. (2) Admins can see every order but cannot cancel or fulfill any. (3) Cancelling an order does not take back the ranking score it gave the listing. Which do you want to save for the whole project?

options.label: Add none
options.description: Nothing is saved; these decisions apply only to this feature.

options.label: Add all listed
options.description: All three are saved for future runs.

questions.question:
El pedido quedó implementado y verificado. Algunas decisiones que tomaste para esta funcionalidad podrían valer para todo el proyecto, y así las próximas ejecuciones no te las volverían a preguntar. ¿Cuáles quieres guardar como decisiones permanentes?
1. Un pedido solo puede cambiar de estado mientras está abierto: cancelado y entregado son estados finales, y repetir una acción se rechaza.
2. Cancelar un pedido no le quita a la publicación el puntaje de ranking que ese pedido le dio.
3. Los administradores pueden ver cualquier pedido, pero no lo cancelan ni lo marcan como entregado.
4. Solo el comprador que hizo un pedido puede cancelarlo, y solo el vendedor dueño de la publicación puede marcarlo como entregado.
Responde con los números que quieras añadir.

options.label: No añadir ninguna
options.description: Las decisiones valen solo para esta funcionalidad; una ejecución futura podría volver a preguntarlas.

options.label: Añadir todas
options.description: Las cuatro se guardan en .uroboros/decisions.md y valen para las próximas funcionalidades.
